digest.component_or_area: plan-review gate E2 measurement and evaluation
propositions: Deterministic mutant corpus, thresholds, and counting helpers were designed and built as WIP on branch calib/6982-e2 but intentionally not landed on main because the harness only exists to drive a rejected LLM batch.
A planned ~100-run live gate sweep to measure detection power and blocking false positives across five seeded defect classes was permanently rejected on cost grounds.

The rejected batch's intended signal (detection rate and false-positive rate per defect class) is now superseded by story d8a5's standing criterion_effectiveness.py recorder, which accumulates the same metrics from real production reviews at zero marginal LLM cost.
Store isolation by construction uses a standalone git clone with its own .git directory to prevent mutations from contaminating the real .tickets-tracker.
History-based baseline mining is dead because only ~4 plan-v3 sidecar baselines exist versus ~200 needed and the impact_model_version bump stranded the history.
